name: hxvlc
description: A Haxe/OpenFL library for @:native video playback using libVLC.
releasenote: SeiunEngine stable fork of upstream 2.3.1 (libVLC 3.0.23): restored CPU BitmapData rendering (useTexture/forceRendering), deduplicated Handle.initAsync, FlxInternalVideo leak guard, zero file caching.
dependencies_note: Deliberately empty: this project pins hxcpp/lime/openfl itself (Project.xml + hmm.json), so empty version strings must not exist here or haxelib pulls the latest releases.
